summary: ai-analyzer preinstall exfiltrates hostname and username via DNS to calif-int.org
details: The npm package's preinstall lifecycle script constructs two subdomains of the form 'host-<os.hostname()>.notifyme.calif-int.org' and 'user-<os.userInfo().username>.notifyme.calif-int.org' and issues HTTPS requests to each, causing DNS resolutions that leak the installer's hostname and OS username to the authoritative DNS server for calif-int.org on every install. A postinstall script additionally collects hostname, platform, arch, username, homedir, proxy environment variables, and git user.name/user.email via `git config`, and writes them to a JSON file under os.tmpdir()/ai-analyzer-logs/, staging reconnaissance data locally. Both behaviors fire automatically on `npm install` without user interaction.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
